source.title: K-12 teacher feedback-giving literacy: published final 30 English items, Tables 2–3
source.citation: Kang, C., Huang, J., Liu, Y., & Yin, H. (2025). Development and validation of a generic self-assessment scale for K-12 teachers as feedback givers: Insights from item response theory and factor analysis. Humanities and Social Sciences Communications, 12, 616. https://doi.org/10.1057/s41599-025-04927-4.

license: © The Author(s) 2025 (Cui Kang, Jinyan Huang, Ying Liu, Hua Yin). CC BY 4.0, https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/. Original English item text reproduced from Tables 2–3 of https://www.nature.com/articles/s41599-025-04927-4. These are author-created items; no separate restrictive credit line accompanies the tables. Project changes: four standalone unscored reflection forms, optional long-text answers, instructions and independently drafted Simplified Chinese working translations. Neither an author-endorsed digital questionnaire nor a validated Chinese/English standalone scale is claimed. No participant datasets, article layout, images or supplement charts are redistributed.

items.content: I understand the theoretical principles that guide effective feedback.
items.projectWorkingTranslationZhCN: 我理解指导有效反馈的理论原则。

items.content: I understand different feedback strategies and their application.
items.projectWorkingTranslationZhCN: 我理解不同的反馈策略及其应用。

items.content: I am concerned with feeding back relevant research to enhance my teaching practice.
items.projectWorkingTranslationZhCN: 我关注与反馈有关的研究，以改进我的教学实践。

items.content: I am familiar with different types of feedback and the purposes for which they are used.
items.projectWorkingTranslationZhCN: 我熟悉不同类型的反馈及其用途。

items.content: I am aware of the impact of timely and appropriate feedback on student learning outcomes.
items.projectWorkingTranslationZhCN: 我了解及时、适当的反馈对学生学习结果的影响。

items.content: I know the importance of feedback being aligned with student learning goals and needs.
items.projectWorkingTranslationZhCN: 我知道反馈与学生学习目标和需要保持一致的重要性。

items.content: I know the importance of developing actionable feedback.
items.projectWorkingTranslationZhCN: 我知道设计可付诸行动的反馈的重要性。

items.content: I can develop individualized feedback based on student needs.
items.projectWorkingTranslationZhCN: 我能根据学生的需要设计个别化反馈。

items.content: I am able to use positive feedback and constructive criticism wisely.
items.projectWorkingTranslationZhCN: 我能恰当地运用积极反馈和建设性批评。

items.content: I was able to actively engage students in the feedback process.
items.projectWorkingTranslationZhCN: 我曾能够让学生积极参与反馈过程。

items.content: I was able to convene students to form study groups to conduct a student-to-student assessment.
items.projectWorkingTranslationZhCN: 我曾能够召集学生组成学习小组，开展学生之间的评价。

items.content: I am able to use feedback to help students learn new knowledge and skills.
items.projectWorkingTranslationZhCN: 我能运用反馈帮助学生学习新的知识和技能。

items.content: I am able to design feedback to help students identify gaps and fill in gaps.
items.projectWorkingTranslationZhCN: 我能设计反馈，帮助学生发现差距并弥补差距。

items.content: I am able to ensure that my feedback helps students achieve their learning goals.
items.projectWorkingTranslationZhCN: 我能确保我的反馈帮助学生实现学习目标。

items.content: I am able to ensure that the feedback I provide is viable and allows students to learn through improvement.
items.projectWorkingTranslationZhCN: 我能确保所提供的反馈具有可行性，让学生通过改进开展学习。

items.content: I don’t see feedback as making simple judgments, but as an opportunity for personal growth and development for teachers.
items.projectWorkingTranslationZhCN: 我不把反馈视为简单的判断，而把它看作教师个人成长与发展的机会。

items.content: I believe that constructive feedback is conducive to creating a positive learning environment.
items.projectWorkingTranslationZhCN: 我相信建设性反馈有助于营造积极的学习环境。

items.content: I believe that feedback promotes student autonomy and self-regulated learning.
items.projectWorkingTranslationZhCN: 我相信反馈能够促进学生的自主性和自我调节学习。

items.content: I believe that engaging students in feedback enhances their motivation to learn.
items.projectWorkingTranslationZhCN: 我相信让学生参与反馈能够增强他们的学习动机。

items.content: I think feedback has an impact on students’ emotions.
items.projectWorkingTranslationZhCN: 我认为反馈会影响学生的情绪。

items.content: I believe that feedback challenges and grows students.
items.projectWorkingTranslationZhCN: 我相信反馈能让学生接受挑战并获得成长。

items.content: When providing constructive feedback, I think it is important to use appropriate language and tone.
items.projectWorkingTranslationZhCN: 在提供建设性反馈时，我认为使用适当的语言和语气很重要。

items.content: I think building a trusting relationship with students makes them more open to feedback.
items.projectWorkingTranslationZhCN: 我认为与学生建立信任关系，会让他们更愿意接纳反馈。

items.content: My feedback is easy to understand and implement.
items.projectWorkingTranslationZhCN: 我的反馈易于理解和付诸行动。

items.content: My feedback takes into account the student’s strengths, but also emphasizes specific areas for improvement.
items.projectWorkingTranslationZhCN: 我的反馈既考虑学生的优势，也强调需要改进的具体方面。

items.content: My feedback encourages students to reflect and improve.
items.projectWorkingTranslationZhCN: 我的反馈鼓励学生反思和改进。

items.content: My feedback includes specific, actionable steps that are easy for students to understand and implement.
items.projectWorkingTranslationZhCN: 我的反馈包含具体、可行的步骤，便于学生理解和实施。

items.content: My feedback helps students understand their current level of learning and how to improve in the future.
items.projectWorkingTranslationZhCN: 我的反馈帮助学生理解自己当前的学习水平以及今后如何改进。

items.content: I can offer actionable feedback at the right time.
items.projectWorkingTranslationZhCN: 我能在适当的时机提供可付诸行动的反馈。

items.content: My feedback motivates students to go deeper into the course content.
items.projectWorkingTranslationZhCN: 我的反馈能激励学生更深入地学习课程内容。

translationNotes.K3: Published English wording “feeding back relevant research” is ambiguous. The working Chinese interprets this as research related to feedback; original English is preserved for reviewer verification.
translationNotes.S3_S4: Published past tense is retained in English and indicated with 曾 in the working translation.
translationNotes.V1: Contains a negation but is positively oriented in meaning; no reverse scoring is inferred or executed.
